title: Wildheart
html:
Wildheart is one of the Subclasses of Barbarian. These Barbarians are attuned with nature and the beasts that live in it. Their rages resemble the animals that inspired them.

“
Your attunement with nature and its beasts inspires your rage, empowering you with supernatural might.
„

Subclass features

This subclass obtains all the features from its base class, Barbarian, in addition to its unique features outlined below.

Level 3

 Speak with Animals ()
Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Bestial Heart
Choose a Bestial Heart from the table below. From here on out, every time you gain a level in Barbarian, you may replace your current Bestial Heart with a different one as an optional choice. You may also choose an alternate appearance
Bestial Hearts Description Grants
Bear Heart While Raging, you can use Unrelenting Ferocity, and have Resistance to all damage except psychic damage. Rage: Bear Heart

Unrelenting Ferocity

Eagle Heart While Raging, you can use Diving Strike. Foes also have  Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use  Dash as a bonus action. Rage: Eagle Heart

Diving Strike

Elk Heart While Raging, you can use Primal Stampede, and your Movement Speed increases by 4.5 m (15 ft). Rage: Elk Heart

Primal Stampede

Tiger Heart While Raging, you can use Tiger's Bloodlust, and your jump distance increases by 4.5 m (15 ft). Rage: Tiger Heart

Tiger's Bloodlust

Wolf Heart While Raging, you can use Inciting Howl, and your allies have  Advantage on melee  Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft) of you. Rage: Wolf Heart

Inciting Howl

Level 6

Animal Aspect
Choose an Aspect of the Beast from the table below:
Aspects of the Beast Description
Bear Your carrying capacity is doubled, and you have  Advantage on  Strength Checks.
Chimpanzee You gain Resistance to fall damage, and throwing Camp Supplies  Blinds targets.
Crocodile Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while standing in water-based surfaces. On slippery surfaces, you also have  Advantage on  Saving Throws against being knocked prone.
Eagle You see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft), and gain  Advantage on  Perception Checks.
Elk Grant yourself and nearby allies (18 m (60 ft)) +1.5 m (5 ft) permanent movement speed.
Honey Badger If you're  Poisoned,  Frightened or  Charmed at the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to begin Raging without expending a Rage Charge.
Stallion  Dashing grants you  temporary hit points equal to twice your barbarian level.
Tiger You add an additional Strength modifier to  Attack Rolls against  Bleeding or  Poisoned targets, and gain proficiency in Survival.
Wolf You and nearby allies (18 m (60 ft)) add your Dexterity modifier as a bonus to your  Stealth Checks.
Wolverine When you attack a  Bleeding or  Poisoned target, you inflict  Maim on them.

Level 8

Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.  Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.

The following are features not listed anywhere, but are nonetheless granted:

Land's Stride: Advantage
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. You have  Advantage on  Saving Throws against plants that are magically created to impede your movement.
Land's Stride: Plants
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Plant-based surfaces with thorns, spines, or similar hazards no longer harm you.

Level 10

You may select an additional Aspect of the Beast to benefit from, in addition to your current Animal Aspect.

Appearance

Choose 1 (Optional)

  • Bear Piercings
  • Eagle Piercings
  • Elk Piercings
  • Tiger Piercings
  • Wolf Piercings
